cards.name: Chrono-Saur Brachio

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand procedure requires two opponent monsters and an available zone.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Special Summoned; You can add 1 "Chrono-Saur" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed Special Summon trigger searches a 0xdae7 Spell/Trap.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Chrono-Saur" monster from your hand or GY, except "Chrono-Saur Brachio".
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_DESTROYED trigger checks REASON_EFFECT and summons another archetype monster from hand/GY.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY, except "Zoodiac Ramram"; Special Summon it. An Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior [b]and[/b] has this card as material gains this effect.
● [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a Trap Card or effect that targets this card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] the activation.
